-- What time scales does the solver contain? --
The delayed path is a STATIC SS-selection rule: it never integrates W(t_gap)=W0*exp(-2*Gamma_k*t_gap).
Omega_1 (seed ringdown) = 1/Gamma1 = 774.014 ns-equivalent units: Gamma1=1.2920 MHz -> 1/Gamma1 = 774.0136 ns; tau_mem=1/(2 Gamma1) = 387.0068 ns
i.e. with damping=0.0005 the doc Eq.(10) predicts tau_mem ~ 387.007 ns, NOT a function of Delta: no regime boundary in analyzeTwoMode can produce a Delta-dependent memory lifetime
